scenario: A property management company processes rental applications. An analyst loads a CSV of applicant financial profiles (monthly income amounts, employment type, rental history), normalizes the data into a structured applicant record, computes a composite tenant approval score, and produces a leasing-decision memo for each applicant.
info_flow: csv-pipeline ingests the applicant financial CSV and outputs a normalized JSON record per applicant → afrexai-real-estate-engine applies the tenant screening scoring rubric to produce a composite approval score and recommendation → reporting generates the leasing-decision memo.
